brief.strategy: Low-to-the-ground aggro with cheap Vampires and go wide on tokens.

commander.name: Edgar Markov
commander.text:
Eminence — Whenever you cast another Vampire spell, if Edgar Markov wasn't on the battlefield, create a 1/1 black Vampire creature token with lifelink.
Whenever Edgar Markov attacks, if you attacked with three or more Vampires this combat, exile the top ten cards of target player's library and put a permanent card from among them onto the battlefield under your control.

brief.strategy: Gain life every turn and drain opponents with payoffs that care about life totals.

commander.name: Oloro, Ageless Ascetic
commander.text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, if Oloro, Ageless Ascetic is in your command zone, you gain 2 life.
Pay 2 life: Draw a card.

brief.strategy: Ramp with extra land drops and landfall payoffs that refill your hand.

commander.name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
commander.text: Landfall — Whenever a land enters the battlefield under your control, Tatyova, Benthic Druid explores, then you may return a land you control to its owner's hand.

brief.strategy: Mill opponents and reanimate the best creatures from graveyards.
